Assets.NotesMarkdown: The dealer queue alert chimes once when a new order arrives and reminds you every 30 seconds while orders wait, from any screen; it stops the moment the queue is empty, and you can switch it off in Settings, Sounds. Sign in inside the main window, with a Live or Demo stream choice; session expired and switch account appear in the window too. Every password field has a show/hide eye and a Caps Lock warning. Notifications is back in the menu, and one event is one row: a margin call shows its updates, a stop-out lists its tickets. Dealing shows full labels at every size, the Hedge table has its header, and Dealer P/L is one number. The Server cell says Connected, Reconnecting or Disconnected. Clients, All now includes closed and suspended accounts.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Groups: a group can now have its own volume step. The Add and Edit group form has a new Volume step (lots) field next to the minimum and maximum volume: allowed volumes go from the minimum in whole steps (for example 0.05, 0.10, 0.15), and a blank step keeps each symbol's own step. The form checks the number as you save, and if the step does not fit a symbol's own volume step the reason is shown in the form. The step also appears in the group's details and in Save as CSV.

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
Backoffice 1.0.84: the Reason column of the client ledger, the Open transaction details, Copy row and the account statement CSV no longer show "(automatic)" for closes by stop loss, take profit or stop-out. They read "Stop loss hit", "Take profit hit" and "Stop-out: margin level X% at or below Y%". Demo closes still say "(demo)". Only what is shown changes; the stored text is untouched.
 Updates now install only when you choose: click "Update available" and confirm to restart into the new version, or close the app and it installs as it closes; it never restarts or closes by itself.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.85: the Columns menu (and the Dealing market watch columns menu) no longer shifts its labels when you tick or untick a column. Settings now has a Check for updates button under the version and build: it says whether you are on the latest version, offers Update now when there is one, and never installs anything on its own. The account statement can now be saved as an HTML page (broker logo, print and PDF friendly) or an Excel workbook (one sheet each for open positions, closed deals, ledger and summary) as well as CSV; the HTML and Excel versions show commission and swap as the client sees them. Signing in again or resuming a saved session now always uses one session.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.91: a new look and a steadier connection. One theme across every screen (IBM Plex fonts, one set of colours, light and dark), with clear buttons in every inspector and the execution detail shown under each trade. Account numbers in every list are links: one click opens the client, Back returns to the screen you came from, and a double-click on a row opens the client too. Open client is the first item in every right-click menu. Live tables keep their order while you work (closed positions leave in place, sorting waits 30 s), and the client view shows the same trade summary as the server. If the connection drops for more than 5 s, a small DISCONNECTED label appears, prices grey out and actions wait until it is back; short drops are silent. New sounds: a new order in the dealer queue and a 30 s reminder, with master and per-sound volume in Settings > Sounds. The backoffice no longer plays client sounds (margin call, stop-out, fills).

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.92: sounds you can check, tidier inspectors and plainer words. Settings > Sounds has a TEST button on every sound, and orders already waiting when you sign in now chime once; a new set of 21 sounds ships with it, including one when a hedge is not completed and one when prices go stale (and when they recover). Notifications, Symbols, Groups, Trading halt and Margin use the same button grid as the other inspectors, and on Dealing only ACCEPT ALL is the main button. Every execution block (Live exposure, Closed trades, the client view) shows Slippage in points (green when better for the client, red when worse), Requested at and Executed at with full times, and Execution time. Empty screens use one wording ("Nothing pending", "No record selected", "No partners"), the approvals and halt titles are shorter, a symbol that cannot be enabled explains why in full, repeated "Marked notification read" lines in staff activity are one line, and the ORDER CONFIRM tile says "no orders yet" until there is data.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.93: calmer lists, a tidier client view and plainer routing words. No list selects a row by itself any more: each inspector says what to click ("Select an account to view", "Select a trade to view", "Select a group to view"). The bulk-action bar now appears inside the filter row only while rows are ticked, so the table never moves, the "Tick rows" strip is gone, and every search box sits right after the filter chips. The client view puts Back in the client header, shows LIVE and DEMO as the same badge as the lists, keeps the positions and closed trades panel at the bottom with its summary bar, and has a compact sign-in history (last 5, with "All sign-ins…") under the trade detail. The client view, Closed trades and Reports share one range row (TODAY, 3D, 7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y, CUSTOM). Routing reads only B-book or A-book, with a "Handled by" row when a dealer filled the order. The VOID and DELETE buttons on a closed trade are a small pair, the Live exposure execution card has the same plain border as every panel, and chart date labels pick their step from the range and never repeat.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.94: a tidier client view and trades tables, prices that stay put, and the group's client name. Back in the client header is now just an arrow; hover it and it says where it goes ("Back to Live exposure"), and it never touches the breadcrumb at any window width. The trades tables (the client's positions and closed trades, and Closed trades) size their columns to what they hold: volume, prices, swap, commission, P/L and ticket keep a fixed width and are right-aligned, text columns fit their text, and with the trade detail or inspector open the table no longer scrolls sideways at 1366 (CCY, CLOSED, DURATION, OPENED, COMMISSION and SWAP step aside only as far as needed, and COLUMNS still brings them back). When the price stream is down, open positions keep their last known current price and floating P/L, greyed, instead of going blank, and they turn live again on reconnect. Groups show the name clients see in a CLIENT NAME column and in the group figures, and the group form has "Name shown to clients" (1 to 40 characters; clients see this, never the group name).

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.95: a polish pass across the whole backoffice, plus the Liquidity screens. Settings: sounds keep one master volume and every sound is a name, an on/off switch and TEST (Disconnected and Reconnected now have their own switches); the accent colour shown is the one the app really uses; margin call and stop-out say "per group"; the sidebar no longer repeats the firm name. Deposits & withdrawals: two compact dropdowns (range TODAY to 1Y or custom, and scope All, one group, A-book or B-book, default All and 30 days) filter the tables on all four tabs (the cards stay on the server's 30-day windows; REJECTED counts all time); the balance column is gone until the server sends a balance after each transaction; a request recorded by staff reads a plain "Recorded · short name" (the full e-mail is in the side panel); the empty "none waiting" text is gone. Live exposure: the risk-limit strip is gone (a limit that is close shows as a chip in the new totals bar under Open positions: positions, buy, sell and net lots, average open price for one symbol, client floating P/L and swap), the symbol table has a TOTAL row, every count is the client book with the broker's own hedge legs said apart, net volume and net exposure read in plain text, and only profit and loss are coloured by sign. Client view: one Ledger panel (money moves only, with an "Include trade P/L" switch; no balance-after column), trades split into OPEN and CLOSED tabs (open trades show the current price), one page range for the chart, trades, ledger and summary, panels numbered in reading order, a sign-in table with date, time, IP and platform, the client card's account rows fit on a 1366 x 768 screen, and the trade detail no longer jumps to the top while you scroll it (nor does any other side panel). Dashboard: "Close to stop-out" lists the five lowest margin levels (a click opens the Margin page), a FLAGS column with plain words and a large-position flag ("1.00 lot · 64% of book"), a bigger Approvals panel, staff activity as time, area, what and who, empty panels keep their size, and the broker's result is labelled Broker P/L. A-book and B-book are the names everywhere ("Market book" is gone). The Liquidity screens are included: providers, routing rules and symbols, with a CONNECTED badge that follows the live link to your liquidity providers.
Assets.NotesHTML: Backoffice 1.0.95: a polish pass across the whole backoffice, plus the Liquidity screens. Settings: sounds keep one master volume and every sound is a name, an on/off switch and TEST (Disconnected and Reconnected now have their own switches); the accent colour shown is the one the app really uses; margin call and stop-out say "per group"; the sidebar no longer repeats the firm name. Deposits & withdrawals: two compact dropdowns (range TODAY to 1Y or custom, and scope All, one group, A-book or B-book, default All and 30 days) filter the tables on all four tabs (the cards stay on the server's 30-day windows; REJECTED counts all time); the balance column is gone until the server sends a balance after each transaction; a request recorded by staff reads a plain "Recorded · short name" (the full e-mail is in the side panel); the empty "none waiting" text is gone. Live exposure: the risk-limit strip is gone (a limit that is close shows as a chip in the new totals bar under Open positions: positions, buy, sell and net lots, average open price for one symbol, client floating P/L and swap), the symbol table has a TOTAL row, every count is the client book with the broker's own hedge legs said apart, net volume and net exposure read in plain text, and only profit and loss are coloured by sign. Client view: one Ledger panel (money moves only, with an "Include trade P/L" switch; no balance-after column), trades split into OPEN and CLOSED tabs (open trades show the current price), one page range for the chart, trades, ledger and summary, panels numbered in reading order, a sign-in table with date, time, IP and platform, the client card's account rows fit on a 1366 x 768 screen, and the trade detail no longer jumps to the top while you scroll it (nor does any other side panel). Dashboard: "Close to stop-out" lists the five lowest margin levels (a click opens the Margin page), a FLAGS column with plain words and a large-position flag ("1.00 lot · 64% of book"), a bigger Approvals panel, staff activity as time, area, what and who, empty panels keep their size, and the broker's result is labelled Broker P/L. A-book and B-book are the names everywhere ("Market book" is gone). The Liquidity screens are included: providers, routing rules and symbols, with a CONNECTED badge that follows the live link to your liquidity providers.
